in_marathi.name: Madira
in_marathi.long_meaning: Madira हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Madhu' which means 'nectar'. In Hindu mythology, 'Madira' is a name for the elixir of immortality, often represented by the drink 'Soma Ras', made from the sap of a sacred tree. It symbolizes sweetness, purity, and the nectar of life.
